review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_GAME_DIR) and the engine image (CS_ENGINE_IMAGE); the report is derived from the recorded log plus a second production pass recorded in rocket-type-table.json. MEASURED (ids, record names, addresses and counts only; provenance static, never verified_original): the engine's rocket id mapper (0x4440f0, jump table 0x444148) sends rocket ids 0..10 to weapon records wep_05, wep_06, wep_07, wep_08, wep_09, wep_15, wep_13, wep_12, wep_10, wep_11, wep_14 and answers none for any other id; through cs_content::ordnance::read_original_rocket_type_table each of the eleven records exists in weapons.zrd and declares a NAME; the classified records no rocket id reaches are wep_04, wep_24, wep_25, wep_26, wep_27. The slot installer 0x4b2550 takes a slot's count from 0x4bad90, the dword at (record + 0x210) + 0xc of the wep_%02d record, with no per-type stack, hardpoint weight or cost table in the plane-record or loadout path. NOT CLAIMED: any original-run behavior (retail is read access, no agent ran the original); which record key fills (record + 0x210) + 0xc (AMMO_LIMIT is only a candidate), the hardpoint weight and cost (no engine read found; the ohardpointweight/ohardpointcost names are absent from the image), the callbacks 2243/2245/2230 and handlers 5058/2031/2037, the media mapping and the equipment-rule census, which stay with the parent task T452-R.03. The claim is implemented: a code and test pass awards nothing above that, and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
